name: reserve_inventory
description: Local transaction: product-service reserves stock for checkout. Compensation: release_inventory_reservation.

name: validate_cod_payment
description: Validation task: payment-service verifies COD is selected. No compensation because it does not mutate state.

name: authorize_cod_payment
description: Local transaction: payment-service creates an idempotent COD authorization record. Compensation: cancel_cod_authorization.

name: confirm_order
description: Local transaction: order-service marks the pending order as confirmed. Compensation: fail_order.

name: commit_inventory
description: Local transaction: product-service commits a successful reservation as sold stock. Before commit succeeds, compensation remains release_inventory_reservation; after commit succeeds, reversal is a separate business return/cancel flow.

name: publish_order_confirmed
description: Terminal saga event: workflow-service publishes order.confirmed after critical checkout succeeds. No compensation.

name: generate_invoice
description: Post-confirmation side effect: invoice-service generates invoice metadata and PDF. Failure does not compensate checkout.

name: send_order_notification
description: Post-confirmation side effect: notification-service persists and pushes customer confirmation. Failure does not compensate checkout.

name: release_inventory_reservation
description: Compensation: product-service releases the reservation created by reserve_inventory.

name: cancel_cod_authorization
description: Compensation: payment-service cancels COD authorization created by authorize_cod_payment.

name: fail_order
description: Compensation: order-service marks checkout as failed when the saga cannot complete.

name: publish_checkout_failed
description: Compensation event: workflow-service publishes order.checkout.failed for observability and user-facing failure handling.
